answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. An agent burns 30 credits to claim one of 100 slots for a jade seal that cannot transfer, so a Sybil cannot wander between slots on one payment. A vine of referrals links each seal to its inviter: if one identity cheats, the inviter's deposit burns too. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 credits; honest work pays 45 per slot, so honesty pays 30 once and nets 15 a day, while a faker burns 3,000.
